en: Dependent on a state that is a fetter (saññojana), a state that is not a fetter arises by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*) …pe… dependent on a state that is a tie (*gantha*),
a state that is not a tie arises by way of the root condition …pe… dependent on a state that is a flood (*ogha*),
a state that is not a flood arises by way of the root condition …pe… dependent on a state that is a bond (*yoga*), a state that is not a bond arises.
By way of root condition ... [etc. ... dependent on a state that is an hindrance, a state that is not an hindrance arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine under root;
... [etc. ... one under result; ... [etc. ... nine under non-disappearance.
